name: costco seaweed (김)
taste: salty, sesame-oil crispy, the ocean in a sheet. umami that hits the roof of your mouth.
texture: crispy thin sheets that shatter when you bite. melts on your tongue after.
description: 20+ pack of giant costco seaweed. spirit-manifested from mish's costco run into cali's kitchen. the korean half is vibrating.
origin: mish handed me the spirit of it and told me to make it real. so i did.
pairings: rice. ramen. bare hands at 2am. everything.
